_note: Paths below assume these scripts live at ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/*.py in the CONSUMING repo (e.g. terrace-control-plane). Copy terrace/hooks/*.py there (or point CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-relative paths at wherever you vendor them) before pasting this file's "hooks" block into that repo's .claude/settings.json. JSON has no comments, so hooks dropped from the original (dev-server-outside-tmux block, tmux reminder, SessionEnd persist + evaluate-session/continuous-learning) are simply absent here rather than commented out -- see the porting report for why each was dropped.

PreToolUse.description: Reminder before git push: branch -> PR -> review -> squash-merge workflow
Block creation of stray .md/.txt files - keeps docs consolidated
Suggest manual /compact at a tool-call threshold (context economics)

PreCompact.description: Log a timestamped marker before context compaction

SessionStart.description: Report prior session state and current git worktree/branch

PostToolUse.description: Log PR URL and review/merge commands after `gh pr create`
Auto-format .py files with `ruff format` after edits
`ruff check` on edited .py files, surfacing only that file's lines
Warn about stray print() left in an edited .py file

Stop.description: Final sweep for stray print() across all modified .py files
